name: build-task
description: A six-phase procedure for making changes to any codebase, with a first-run project setup and a shared cross-project history.

supabase_url.title: Shared history — project URL
supabase_url.description: From your Supabase project: Project Settings -> API -> Project URL. Looks like https://abcdefgh.supabase.co. Leave blank to run without a shared history.

supabase_key.title: Shared history — anon key
supabase_key.description: From the same page: the anon / public key (NOT the service role key). Leave blank to run without a shared history.
